judgments.shared_question_or_object: Whether evidence about a changed software configuration supports its claimed correspondence to the approved functional and operating assumptions.
judgments.domain_horizon_authority: Repeatedly changed software or programmable components whose configuration is being reconciled at a delivery/use decision. Engineering evidence owners may analyze and report; authorized recipients separately accept risk, authorize release or impose legal requirements. No fixed phase sequence.
judgments.evidence_ceiling: Bounded technical/analytical relation grounded in native meanings and inspected guidance. No observed deployment effect, full safety claim, empirical effect size, regulatory applicability or new-property claim. NASA sources share ancestry.
judgments.case_status: AUTHOR_CONSTRUCTED_LOGICAL_CHALLENGES; no field trial or executable benchmark was run.
guard: The receiving reconciliation includes a named functional attribute or behavioral requirement, not solely an inventory identifier.
A regression check genuinely exercises that attribute with a credible oracle and maintained data.
The result is bound by separate trustworthy identification to the tested product and relevant environment; proposed reuse for another state has justified applicability.
Result and discrepancies can reach the actor performing reconciliation; applicable obligations still govern sufficiency.
judgments.source_contribution: EA-06 produces repeatable observations of the named behavior after relevant change. Passing results provide limited functional evidence; a credible failing result identifies a discrepancy that the reconciliation must address.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The reconciliation can reuse an identified regression result as one functional-evidence input, or carry a discovered functional discrepancy rather than report unqualified correspondence. The evidence needed for this part of reconciliation changes even when physical identity, undocumented changes and operational assumptions remain open.
premises_supplied: Observed behavior of the identified tested state for the exercised cases.
A bounded discrepancy or support for the named functional attribute.
premises_remaining: Independent binding of result to product and relevant environment.
Coverage of untested behavior and differences outside the check.
Actual built/deployed state observation, approved deviation/waiver handling and recipient authority.
Test/oracle credibility and any required independent assurance.
judgments.authority_limit: Regression automation neither accepts the configured product nor authorizes operation. Formal audit conventions in NASA guidance are examples within their domain, not universal procedure.
judgments.rationale: EA-06 is a repeatable behavioral-evidence mechanism; EW-P007 includes correspondence between design assumptions, tested state and actual product. NASA functional configuration audit provides a concrete receiving use for such test evidence, while distinguishing physical correspondence. The contribution is this named functional input. It does not rely on a claim that testing proves every aspect of reconciliation.
judgments.counterexample: Two distinct binaries both pass the same narrow test. Treating the green result as proof that the deployed binary is the approved/tested binary fails; this does not defeat the limited functional-input relation.
judgments.nontrigger: A regression suite exercises an unrelated feature while reconciliation concerns only a replaced physical serial number or an unobserved site installation; no receiving functional premise is supplied by that suite.
judgments.counter_control: A requirement-targeted manual check, formal proof or qualified analysis with correct product binding may supply the same limited functional concern. A trustworthy immutable digest can establish an identity concern without behavioral testing.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Reuse an already justified result with exact configuration linkage when possible. Automating a new suite adds oracle design, maintenance, execution and evidence-retention costs; a one-off targeted check may cost less. Duplicate recording without additional receiving use has no demonstrated benefit.
judgments.reentry: Reopen if functional and physical correspondence are conflated, the check does not exercise the claimed attribute, identity or environmental binding is lost, an oracle defect is found, or source/selected meaning changes.

guard: A regression result is being used to support a statement about an actual current configuration or operating environment.
Reconciliation supplies observed state/identity and a discrepancy relevant to the tested behavior or exposes absence of its required correspondence premise.
The difference has not already been covered by sound equivalence or change-impact evidence; merely cosmetic metadata does not meet this guard.
The receiving test/evidence owner can narrow the claim or seek a relevant recheck without assuming authority to accept residual risk.
judgments.source_contribution: EW-P007 compares intended, tested and operating states and makes relevant discrepancies or residual unknowns explicit. This supplies an applicability criterion for the regression result.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The owner must limit the green result to the supported state or establish validity for the actual state, through justified impact reasoning or a targeted rerun. Unaffected test evidence can remain usable. The meaning of the regression result changes; reconciliation need not execute the tests itself.
premises_supplied: Which observed configuration/environment the result is being attributed to.
A supported match, relevant mismatch or explicit unresolved correspondence condition for evidence applicability.
premises_remaining: What behavior the tests cover, credible oracles and adequacy of test data.
Whether the identified difference changes the tested proposition; if unknown, the scope claim remains limited pending a discriminator.
Competence and authority for any residual-risk decision, and assurance outside regression scope.
judgments.authority_limit: Reconciliation identifies scope and drift; it does not create a universal rerun, certification or release-approval duty. Actual institutional requirements remain independently binding.
judgments.rationale: EA-06 evidence concerns changed behavior, not an arbitrary result detached from a tested object. EW-P007 supplies the correspondence needed to apply that evidence to another/current state. Fowler describes reference-environment verification and the risk from production differences; NASA distinguishes product identity and functional evidence. The reverse consequence is an applicability qualifier, independently established from the forward functional input.
judgments.counterexample: A green suite forversion17in environmentE1 is advertised forversion18after an unexamined parser-library change. Reconciliation identifies the difference: it does not prove a failure occurred, but the unsupported carryover claim must be narrowed or justified.
judgments.nontrigger: A build timestamp changes while a trustworthy analysis establishes that executable behavior and relevant environment assumptions are unchanged. Blanket invalidation or retesting would exceed the guard.
judgments.counter_control: Directly execute a requirement-targeted test against the actual observed state, or establish sound configuration equivalence/impact analysis; either can settle the particular applicability concern without a separate elaborate audit.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: For simple deployments, version/digest and relevant-environment capture may suffice. Full physical audits can be disproportionate. Targeted impact review or tests cost less than blanket reruns when unaffected premises can be shown; maintaining unreliable inventories can add cost while preserving false confidence.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when an apparently harmless difference is shown behaviorally relevant, equivalence evidence fails, actual state is unobservable, or an imposed rerun/authority rule lacks applicable support.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: How can a later maintainer recover a specific current behavioral constraint that must survive change?
guard: The maintained check expresses a durable behavioral expectation through a readable input and credible oracle.
The check and result are discoverable and tied to the relevant configuration.
That expectation is a real future maintenance question, not incidental implementation detail.
judgments.source_contribution: A repeatable executable example preserves the expected behavior and can reveal divergence after a change.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The knowledge record can use this example as one current behavior/evidence carrier, sometimes replacing duplicate prose about the same behavior while retaining rationale and limits elsewhere.
premises_supplied: An executable instance of the named behavioral expectation and its current observation.
premises_remaining: Why the expectation is appropriate, its scope and untested cases.
Discoverability, ownership, maintenance and configuration linkage.
judgments.rationale: EW-P005 explicitly permits tests and executable examples as a cheap knowledge form. EA-06 supplies that form only where a future reader can recover the relevant expectation; automation alone is not documentation. The receiving consequence is concrete recoverability of one constraint, not the complete rationale for the system.
judgments.counterexample: A snapshot test captures an accidental output and offers no interpretable oracle. Keeping it green does not preserve justified intent.
judgments.nontrigger: An opaque, disposable experiment has no durable expectation or later knowledge consumer.
judgments.counter_control: A concise maintained example or decision note with a targeted manual check may preserve the same knowledge more cheaply.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare test readability, maintenance and execution cost with the retrieval value of the behavioral fact. Do not maintain a separate prose copy merely for page count.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when tests become opaque, encode a known defect, lose configuration linkage, or a maintainer needs rationale the example cannot supply.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: Is a candidate revision eligible for promotion to a named authoritative software reference under a defined behavioral-check policy?
guard: The actual promotion policy makes specified regression results one eligibility condition.
The candidate and result are independently identified and the check is relevant and credible.
The actor has the delegated authority to apply the policy; passing tests alone do not create it.
judgments.source_contribution: A relevant pass or failure supplies the policy-defined behavioral evidence input for promotion.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The baseline/status owner can mark the candidate eligible or retain a failed candidate outside the authoritative reference, subject to the other promotion conditions. This changes governed status use without claiming that tests identify the artifact.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: What behavioral consequence of a proposed software change must its impact assessment address?
guard: A change could affect a behavior covered by a credible regression check.
The tested candidate and observed failure or support are identified.
The impact-analysis owner receives the result before relying on the changed state.
judgments.source_contribution: A reproducible failing check can identify an affected behavior; a relevant passing check provides narrower support for a stated impact claim.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The impact assessment records the observed consequence, revises its affected-evidence set or escalation decision, and retains untested dependencies as open premises.
premises_supplied: Observed consequence at the exercised behavior and configuration.
premises_remaining: Unexercised propagation, root cause, rollback effects, external commitments and authorized risk decision.
judgments.rationale: EW-P008 requires consequence visibility, and EA-06 can provide a named observation bearing on that consequence. This does not infer low overall risk from a green suite or create a mandatory serial test-then-approval lifecycle.
judgments.counterexample: A suite omits a supplier protocol and passes; treating that as proof of no supplier impact hides the unresolved dependency.
judgments.nontrigger: The proposed change is a contractual responsibility transfer with no tested behavioral effect.
judgments.counter_control: A targeted analysis, simulation or independent review may identify the consequence more directly than a regression suite.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Use existing relevant checks and investigate meaningful failures; distinguish flaky infrastructure from product evidence. Extra checks and approval queues can delay urgent corrections without reducing the actual uncertainty.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when the oracle is unreliable, the change affects an uncovered dependency, or a pass is used to waive an independent obligation.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: Does a consequential behavioral requirement have a feasible, interpretable verification method?
guard: A maintained check actually evaluates the named requirement with a credible success condition.
Its configuration, environment and resource needs are known at the needed fidelity.
The method is available early enough to inform the requirement or reliance decision.
judgments.source_contribution: The executable check demonstrates one concrete evaluation method and exposes a presently implementable oracle for the requirement.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The verification plan can cite this method, reveal remaining infeasibility or ambiguity, and avoid a separate document merely restating an adequate executable procedure.
premises_supplied: A specific feasible check and interpretable pass/fail condition for its scope.
premises_remaining: Validity and completeness of the requirement, needed independence, representative context and uncovered acceptance conditions.
judgments.rationale: EW-P010 explicitly allows an existing automated assertion to supply a verification plan. EA-06 contributes a concrete method when its oracle and scope match, not the claim that every requirement should be reduced to an automated test.
judgments.counterexample: A tautological test compares a value with itself. It executes reliably but cannot distinguish an implementation that violates the requirement.
judgments.nontrigger: The requirement concerns an unautomatable destructive environment and the software unit check does not exercise it.
judgments.counter_control: A clear analytic criterion, inspection or representative manual experiment may be the feasible evaluation method.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Keep a small meaningful assertion when sufficient; justify facilities and formal plans only for missing concerns. Maintaining a test of the wrong requirement creates both cost and false assurance.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when the oracle cannot discriminate failure, the requirement changes or the available environment ceases to represent the claim.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: Which oracle, article, environment and observation make a proposed regression check meaningful?
guard: Verification planning identifies a consequential requirement and its interpretable acceptance condition.
The proposed repeatable check is intended to evaluate that requirement.
The plan is current and open to revision rather than a rigid prediction of every future test.
judgments.source_contribution: The plan supplies explicit evaluation criteria and context, including any independence or facility condition relevant to the claim.
judgments.receiving_consequence: Regression design can target those criteria, expose an unevaluable requirement or select a manual/analytic alternative when automation is unsuitable.
premises_supplied: Named method, criterion and context for the check.
premises_remaining: Actual execution, oracle credibility beyond paperwork, representative data and cost-effective repeatability.
Intended-use validation distinct from compliance with the stated requirement.
judgments.rationale: EA-06 depends on credible oracles and suitable levels; the source can supply a specific planned evaluation premise. A plan does not make an incorrect requirement valid or guarantee a test detects unanticipated failures.
judgments.counterexample: A perfectly specified test for the wrong units consistently passes the implementation while missing the stakeholder need.
judgments.nontrigger: A throwaway low-risk probe has no persistent requirement warrant and can be checked directly; a formal plan is unnecessary.
judgments.counter_control: Discover an adequate oracle through a small experiment, then record the result in the check itself. No compulsory plan-before-learning sequence follows.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Keep criteria close to the executable check. Revisit them as learning occurs, balancing planning value against premature design lock and maintenance burden.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when planning teaches only to the test, a requirement becomes ambiguous, or independent evidence contradicts the oracle.

guard: The argument names a behavioral subclaim and explains why the chosen check bears on it.
The result has credible oracle, configuration and context binding.
Failures and limitations are admitted into the argument, and the subclaim is not equated with the entire safety claim.
judgments.source_contribution: A repeatable result supplies limited support or a contrary observation for the named subclaim.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The argument can update that subclaim, expose a gap or narrow its scope, while leaving other evidence and residual-risk judgment separate.
premises_supplied: Observed support or counterevidence at the checked behavior and context.
premises_remaining: The inferential connection to higher claims, completeness of hazards and assumptions, independent challenge, authority and evidence outside the check.
judgments.rationale: MASSC distinguishes an evidence collection from the reasoning that connects it to a claim and requires maintained evidence. EA-06 is a potential concrete evidential input when this link is justified. The same check may support several claims but remains one dependent observation, not several independent assurances.
judgments.counterexample: A green pipeline badge is placed beneath a top claim that the aircraft is safe, with no argument about the actual hazards or operational context. The evidence does not justify that leap.
judgments.nontrigger: The suite formats the assurance report but does not evaluate any safety-relevant behavioral subclaim; this is tool co-use only.
judgments.counter_control: A targeted analysis, independent experiment or existing credible evidence can support the same limited subclaim without an automated regression suite.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Reuse relevant results and record their limitations. Creating additional dashboards or repeatedly running irrelevant tests can increase confirmation bias and maintenance cost.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when the argument suppresses contrary results, the context changes, evidence becomes stale or multiple claims are mistaken for independent observations.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: Which feasible reserve can absorb a named demand burst without making routine recovery depend on chronic overtime?
guard: Residual variability or disruption imposes a material workload consequence on the same operation.
The candidate stock, capacity or time reserve has a feasible path to meeting the demand or recovery need.
Authority exists to protect the reserve and allocate its cost.
judgments.source_contribution: The buffer portfolio supplies a specified way to absorb the disturbance: a usable spare, trained reserve capacity, or allowed time, with distinct limits and costs.
judgments.receiving_consequence: The workload plan can evaluate that concrete alternative to routine emergency overwork, or reject a supposed reserve that cannot deliver the needed service. A forecast or spare budget is not automatically usable human capacity.

premises_remaining: Staffing, recovery policy, worker autonomy, actual disturbance frequency, cost distribution and observed welfare outcomes.

judgments.rationale: Regression verification directly performs a defined part of the receiving source-check mechanism. Its materiality is the useful result before propagation, not the mere existence of a test tool or a claim that every regression suite makes release safe.

judgments.reentry: Reopen on new bypass paths, changed legitimate exceptions, shifted error models, environmental changes or discovered adverse effects.

judgments.shared_question_or_object: What a regression oracle must distinguish when checking a mistake-prevention guard.

judgments.receiving_consequence: EA-06 must distinguish selective prevention from indiscriminate rejection. The test design includes relevant allowed cases and exception behavior, and its pass is interpreted as case-bounded support for the modeled error rather than proof against all hazards.
premises_supplied: A more discriminating behavioral oracle and test-selection criterion.
premises_remaining: Correctness of the model and expected results, executable test fidelity, wider consequence evidence and maintenance.

premises_remaining: Valid observation and baseline, an appropriately safe test or other discriminating evidence, actual authority and capacity, and outcome relevance to the wider system.

guard: The initial exposure can actually be restricted and a stage-specific consequence can be assessed.

judgments.reentry: Reopen on recurrence, a corrected signal, changed authority/capacity, a new discriminating hypothesis or evidence against the proposed process explanation.

guard: The observed integrated behavior occurs under a specified containment, stop or fallback state.

judgments.rationale: The reverse contribution changes what the work method may promise or permit under particular exposure conditions. It is not simply the existence of a process to which any technique can be attached.

judgments.reentry: Reopen when stage evidence reveals an unmodeled effect, recovery fails, propagation crosses the assumed boundary or delayed/irreversible outcomes invalidate the current instruction.

judgments.nontrigger: No critical knowledge concentration exists, or the rare low-risk task is adequately served by accessible guidance and timely specialist escalation; a broad cross-skilling programme adds no justified receiving contribution.

Parker participation measures and the NUMMI accounts keep experience distinct from empowerment rhetoric, without proving a single causal governance prescription.

The visible participation records do not establish the claimed usable rights. judgments.nontrigger: The simple low-risk work already has a responsive owner contact and adequate local decision rights; adding committees or a formal participation programme has no established marginal benefit.

judgments.evidence_ceiling: Native analytical contributions supported and qualified by scoped historical training, mixed employee-outcome evidence and normative sustainable-pace principle. No quantified causal welfare, productivity or training effect; measured overload is not identical to all work quality or health outcomes.
judgments.case_status: Four separately reasoned directional interfaces. Existing finite-capacity and signal-versus-response distinctions reused; no new executable model, field exercise or counted challenge.
judgments.overlap_limit: A competence record, rights boundary or workload report can be shared evidence. The same protected time and response effort are charged once; source dependence and shared failure modes prevent multiplying support.
judgments.shared_question_or_object: Whether the apparent match between ordinary demand and sustainable capacity omits unrecorded work or a burden displaced onto particular workers.
judgments.guard: EA-25 is evaluating a concrete recurring workload and its evidence is incomplete or contested; an EL-022 channel enables an affected person to report the omitted burden and obtain an accountable response without improper retaliation. The report has task/horizon relevance.
judgments.source_contribution: Safe reporting and response can surface a specific demand, interruption, hidden overtime or missing recovery period that aggregate planning records omit. It also distinguishes a recorded complaint from a considered disposition or changed workload.
judgments.receiving_consequence: EA-25 can revise the workload boundary, investigate a contested capacity claim or select a feasible demand/recovery response. The report may confirm the existing assessment; neither agreement nor a change of policy is required for the information to be material.
premises_supplied: An affected-person account of a named possible omission and a route for responsible examination.
A reason to qualify a nominal capacity/pace claim until the relevant observation is reconciled.
premises_remaining: The account is interpreted in context and corroborated where needed; neither a single report nor a planning metric is automatically complete.
An authorized owner can alter demand, staffing, scheduling or recovery in a way consistent with other obligations.
Long-term health, performance and causal attribution require separate evidence; reporting does not itself remove the burden.
judgments.rationale: Hidden overtime is a native EA-25 failure and suppressed alarms are a native EL-022 failure. At a specific omitted-work interface, a safe account changes the receiving evidential boundary and response question. This is not a claim that voice generically improves every outcome or that a no-change survey result proves workload is harmless. Parker retains distinct outcome measures; NUMMI includes reports that aggregate assessments did not exhaust workers experience.
judgments.counterexample: A nominal eight-hour plan appears balanced because required after-hours incident work is not recorded. A credible account of that specific work can defeat the completeness premise. A suggestion count with no burden content, or an acknowledged report with no responsible examination, supplies neither corrected demand nor recovery.
judgments.nontrigger: The simple task has adequate transparent workload evidence and a responsive direct owner; a new reporting bureaucracy or intrusive individual-surveillance metric is not warranted.
judgments.counter_control: Proportionate workload/recovery conversations, observable task records or another trusted channel can provide the same missing evidence while protecting privacy.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Charge protected reporting and response time, investigation and any displacement of other work. Compare demand reduction, support, scheduling and explicit recovery without assuming a participation programme or faster cadence creates capacity.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when reports contradict the capacity baseline, burden shifts to another group/time horizon, reporting becomes unsafe or the authorized response proves infeasible.

judgments.guard: EL-022 imposes a concrete response/participation obligation that consumes time or scarce expertise, and EA-25 evaluates that demand alongside existing work and recovery over the relevant horizon.
judgments.source_contribution: EA-25 supplies a workload/capacity boundary, protected learning/maintenance or recovery commitments, and the need for an authorized adjustment when the combined demand does not fit. It makes response work visible rather than treating it as free discretionary labour.

premises_supplied: A concrete capacity constraint on who can respond and when, including workload transferred to reporters or responders.
An explicit comparison of response effort with other commitments and needed recovery.
premises_remaining: Legitimate rights and binding response duties remain; a capacity shortage does not authorize suppression, retaliation or neglect.
An accountable owner has authority to resolve the gap; time allocation alone does not supply competence or a fair decision.
The response is actually performed and protects access/appeal, rather than being inferred from a budget line.
judgments.rationale: The receiving safeguard includes response and protected time, not only collection of suggestions. Sustainable-capacity analysis supplies a necessary feasibility question for the specific promised work and can change its staffing or escalation choice. Existing finite-capacity reasoning applies: the same person-time cannot be counted as fully committed delivery and as available response. This is a resource premise, not a claim that lower load guarantees safe voice.
judgments.counterexample: The sole competent responder is fully assigned to ordinary delivery while every reported problem is promised an immediate investigation. Recording both commitments does not create time for both. Reducing response rights or pressuring workers not to report is not a legitimate resolution of that feasibility gap.
judgments.nontrigger: The low-volume reporting work is already credibly accommodated by a responsive owner and does not create a material competing demand; elaborate capacity instrumentation is unnecessary.
judgments.counter_control: A modest explicit time allowance, a backup responder or an accountable specialist service can make the same response obligation feasible without a broad planning framework.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare reallocation of discretionary work, support, demand reduction and escalation. Account for reporting, triage, investigation, appeals and recovery once, including burden on the workers supplying improvement information.
judgments.reentry: Reopen after demand surges, repeated response delays, lost expertise, exhausted recovery time or evidence that nominal capacity is achieved through hidden unpaid work.

judgments.guard: EL-021 identifies a warranted practice, coaching or competence-refresh task for recurring material work, and EA-25 is assessing sustainable capacity over a horizon in which that work must occur.
judgments.source_contribution: The capability-maintenance requirement supplies a concrete demand for learner/instructor time and a task-specific distinction between demonstrated and merely nominally assignable capacity. judgments.receiving_consequence: EA-25 can account for protected capability work and revise a demand/capacity assessment that treated it as free or assumed interchangeable staff. A valid finding that current guidance/competence is adequate can instead support leaving the plan unchanged.
premises_supplied: A named capability task, applicable skill constraint or justified refresh need relevant to the planning horizon.
The distinction between possessing a skill and having time available to exercise it.
premises_remaining: The amount, timing and value of learning/practice are locally estimated and evidence is applicable.
Authority can adjust demand or resources while maintaining other obligations.
Future capacity gains, health effects and retention cannot be assumed from training completion or a skill matrix.
judgments.rationale: Learning capacity is part of EA-25, but its feasible allocation depends on what capability work is actually needed. EL-021 changes that input with a task-specific requirement and demonstrated-skill boundary. This does not imply that every training programme is necessary or pays back, or that cross-skilled staff supply simultaneous capacity in every area.
judgments.counterexample: A plan fills ordinary hours with delivery and assumes mandatory current-task practice happens without displacing anything. The plan omits a real demand. Conversely, retaining an obsolete certification requirement can consume capacity without a justified material capability benefit.
judgments.nontrigger: The task is rare and low-risk with adequate guidance/escalation, or current demonstrated competence needs no additional practice within the horizon; broad training is not an automatic workload requirement.
judgments.counter_control: A targeted task/coverage assessment can justify a smaller refresh, accessible instruction or reliable specialist support instead of generalized cross-skilling.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Count learner, coach, assessment, coverage-during-training and upkeep time; compare the expected task need with simpler guidance or specialist backup. Keep future payoff uncertain and charge the same protected time once.
judgments.reentry: Reopen after task/baseline changes, failed response, skill decay, changed practice costs or evidence that supposedly protected learning time is displaced into overtime.

judgments.guard: EA-26 is relying on a reported knowledge-transfer or backup-coverage claim for a critical task, and EL-022 enables an affected person to identify a concrete gap and receive a responsible examination without improper retaliation.
judgments.source_contribution: A protected report can identify the exact task or explanation that remains inaccessible, distinguish acknowledgement from a resolved knowledge gap, and provide an appeal route if the coverage claim is disputed by its nominal owner.
judgments.receiving_consequence: EA-26 can narrow or reopen the coverage claim and choose a targeted explanation, practice, different backup or retained specialist interface. The report does not itself prove the gap is resolved, and a credible confirmation can support the existing arrangement.
premises_supplied: A specific counter-observation or clarification relevant to the claimed distribution of critical understanding.
A responsible route for resolving a contested coverage assertion rather than equating attendance or forced agreement with understanding.
premises_remaining: The claim is assessed against the actual task and privacy/legitimate access constraints.
Available competent people and time can address the gap; reporting does not supply the missing knowledge.
Rights, willingness to speak and knowledge competence are separately evidenced; there is no guaranteed reduction in turnover or failure.
judgments.rationale: EA-26 can fail through shallow rotation or nominal knowledge sharing. At that precise uncertainty, EL-022 changes what the receiving evidence warrants by making a task-specific dissent or admission usable. This is a bounded informational contribution, not a claim that every voice mechanism causes knowledge resilience. A silent participant cannot automatically be counted as either competent or incapable.
judgments.counterexample: A newcomer signs a walkthrough record under pressure but cannot explain the emergency procedure and is discouraged from asking further questions. The signed attendance is real; the critical-knowledge claim remains unsupported. A safe specific question can expose the gap without establishing the eventual remedy.
judgments.nontrigger: No relevant concentration or disputed understanding exists, or the adequate direct owner channel already permits clarification; a formal participation programme adds no necessary coverage evidence.
judgments.counter_control: An appropriate task demonstration or a confidential bounded capability review can test the same coverage claim. These alternatives should preserve legitimate reporting protections and avoid coercive surveillance.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Include protected questioning, explanation, response and appeal time; compare focused transfer or maintained specialist backup. Do not count the same clarification as both independent testimony and independent technical validation.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when a specific task cannot be performed, records conflict with affected-person accounts, the reporting channel becomes unsafe, or critical understanding is lost after turnover/change.

Shared training or documentation may preserve a common misconception; an additional knower is not automatically independent corroboration.
judgments.rationale: The receiving property includes substantive response, which can be obstructed by a critical knowledge bottleneck. EA-26 changes that specific epistemic/response premise when an actual backup can understand the contested issue. It does not create rights or fairness, and collective ownership is not equivalent to an independent appeal body. This differs from the forward direction, which supplies a report that tests a knowledge-coverage claim.
judgments.counterexample: Several people share the same mistaken explanation copied from one document; their agreement is not independent support for rejecting a worker report. Conversely, a genuinely competent accessible backup can examine the specific issue during the primary experts absence even though formal disposition still belongs to another legitimate owner.
judgments.nontrigger: The report needs no scarce technical expertise, or a responsive competent owner already supplies the required information; broader collective stewardship has no established marginal response contribution.
judgments.counter_control: An independent specialist, a focused record or an explicit backup service can supply the same limited technical understanding without universal collective ownership or mandatory pairing.

judgments.reentry: Reopen after loss of the backup, changed technical context, a revealed shared misconception, an independence conflict or inability to obtain a timely competent response.

judgments.domain_horizon_authority: A particular improvement or responsibility change affecting employment, workload, compensation, redeployment or supplier terms, with an identified affected population and transition/continuation horizon.
judgments.authority_limit: Treat actual legitimate commitments and decision rights as context, without inventing a universal employment guarantee, consent rule or legal conclusion. Local teams cannot promise terms or resources controlled elsewhere.
judgments.evidence_ceiling: Contextual institutional/analytical contributions, informed by mixed primary employee-outcome cases. No automatic trust, welfare, causal productivity or universal fair-transition design. Reported performance, self-report outcomes and normative distributional choices remain distinct.
judgments.case_status: Four independently authored directions; hypothetical counterexamples are bounded reasoning, not actual employment changes or field trials.
judgments.overlap_limit: The same role description, workload observation or transition commitment may serve both properties; it is one input and one cost. Local improvement and transferred burden are reported separately, not netted away without a legitimate objective and common unit.
judgments.shared_question_or_object: Whether expanding a teams operating responsibility is supportable under the actual employment/workload and transition terms of those expected to carry it.
judgments.guard: EA-18 is considering a concrete responsibility or delegation change that materially changes duties or burdens, and EL-023 supplies relevant credible terms or identifies a specific affected party and unresolved commitment.
judgments.source_contribution: EL-023 makes the proposed shift in duties, compensation, workload, redeployment or supplier exposure explicit, together with who can actually commit to those terms. It distinguishes a formal gain in local authority from an unfunded transfer of responsibility.
judgments.receiving_consequence: EA-18 can narrow or redesign the proposed ownership boundary, retain a specialist service, secure the relevant authorized commitment or disclose a transition issue before treating the new arrangement as supportable. Existing suitable terms can confirm an unchanged boundary.
premises_supplied: A relevant employment/transition constraint or distributional consequence of the proposed responsibility boundary.
The identity of the actor able to make the applicable commitment, distinct from the local teams technical autonomy.
premises_remaining: Competence, capacity and legitimate system/assurance boundaries separately support the assigned work.
The promised terms are credible and performed; a statement alone does not establish trust or security.
Fairness judgments and effects on all affected people need their own warrant; no universal job-security policy follows.
judgments.rationale: EA-18 admits only supportable bounded autonomy. When a role change transfers on-call, maintenance or improvement work, the actual terms of carrying that burden change its supportability assessment. EL-023 supplies those named constraints and qualifiers; it is not a generic moral endorsement of teamwork. More technical discretion does not by itself compensate for an adverse change in other terms.
judgments.counterexample: A team is given discretion over implementation but also assigned continuous support without a credible coverage or workload arrangement. The discretion is real, yet it does not establish that the expanded boundary is supportable or that transition promises are fulfilled. Conversely, an adequately supported specialist service can be a legitimate choice.
judgments.nontrigger: A small local choice has no material employment/workload or supplier effect and existing terms suffice. Monitor cumulative changes where relevant rather than inventing a negotiation programme for every routine task.
judgments.counter_control: A concise explicit role/coverage agreement and accountable response to affected people can clarify the same terms without adopting a named transformation framework.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare narrower ownership, a shared specialist interface, funded support and an amended transition arrangement. Include coverage, training, negotiation, compensation where relevant and burdens displaced outside the team; count existing adequate provisions as the baseline.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when added duties, staffing, financial feasibility, supplier exposure or observed fulfillment contradict the assumed terms, or when small changes accumulate into a material burden.

EL-023.criterion: Identify who gains, loses or carries risk and whether commitments are credible; do not turn doctrine into an observed worker outcome.

judgments.receiving_consequence: Use the bounded evidence to select, retain or reject the proposed intervention or gain claim; investigate a consequential missing recipient or cost.

judgments.rationale: A diagnostic metric can show a task improvement without proving that the programme caused it or that gains were fair. Adequate narrow evidence remains useful when these broader claims are withheld.
judgments.counterexample: Before/after output gains are attributed wholly to a development programme despite selection and changed conditions, or supplier time is excluded because the buyer paid no consulting invoice.
judgments.nontrigger: The measure supplies no usable information about the particular dependency or decision.
judgments.counter_control: Use a focused task check and accurate existing cost records; separate a supported operational result from unproved causal and distributional claims.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare the smallest adequate evidence with its collection burden. Preserve a routine qualified purchase, alternative source or no change where supported.
judgments.reentry: Reenter when the data, comparison, incentives, omitted costs, task or decision purpose changes.

judgments.guard: The proposed resilience option depends on decisions whose rights, competence or resource boundaries are unclear, misplaced or materially delayed.
judgments.source_contribution: Explicit bounded decision rights and the associated competence/resource conditions identify who may access the data, reserve capacity, authorize a switch or invoke the legitimate escalation path.
judgments.receiving_consequence: Classify the option as usable only at its actual authority scope and activation conditions; repair a missing authority premise or retain it as an unresolved feasibility condition.

premises_remaining: Real technical compatibility, qualification and spare capacity.
Accurate dependency data, lead time and alternative availability during the relevant disturbance.
External supplier, contractual and assurance permissions not delegated to the team.
judgments.rationale: Feasibility includes usable authority as well as physical capability. Delegation can resolve a particular activation dependency, but a team label or an internal permission cannot create rights over a supplier’s resources.
judgments.counterexample: An alternate has compatible equipment and a documented contact, but the local team cannot obtain the required release or reserve that equipment. Conversely, an existing authorized service owner already provides a timely route without further delegation.
judgments.nontrigger: The proposed option does not depend on team-level decision rights, or all relevant authority premises are already explicitly adequate.
judgments.counter_control: Retain a functioning existing owner or expedited route; record its actual scope and activation conditions rather than adding another approval layer.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare bounded delegation, pre-authorized conditions, an existing service contract or another feasible option. Include competence/access upkeep and coordination cost; do not presume decentralization always wins.
judgments.reentry: Reenter when delegation, external permissions, actors, response deadlines or the proposed recovery action changes.

premises_remaining: Evidence of who actually possesses the required usable knowledge.
Competent available backup, legitimate access and activation rights.
Technical feasibility and other recovery resources.
judgments.rationale: Dependency analysis can identify the consequence and time sensitivity of losing a particular maintenance capability. It does not identify expertise merely by listing a supplier, nor does it train a substitute. The contribution is prioritization at the named task boundary.
judgments.counterexample: A rarely modified component has a long restoration path and only one maintainer able to perform a necessary recovery step; its knowledge risk is missed by prioritizing only frequently edited code. Conversely, a supplier name on a map proves no concentration of human knowledge.
judgments.nontrigger: No knowledge-concentration issue is relevant to the identified dependency task, or an existing adequate backup already covers the required scope.
judgments.counter_control: Use a targeted walkthrough, supported specialist backup or maintained critical instruction rather than universal pairing or equal expertise.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare knowledge transfer, a supported external service, a tested replacement or removal of the dependency. Include learning, access upkeep and scarce-specialist time; preserve an adequate existing arrangement.
judgments.reentry: Reenter when dependency criticality, task requirements, maintainers, backup availability or recovery lead time changes.

judgments.guard: A maintained codebase is expected to change, and a proposed restructuring affects assumptions shared with another discipline, downstream operation or long-lived interface; those constraints are not already adequately understood.
judgments.source_contribution: Reusable trade-off knowledge and affected-discipline input identify the expected change, invariant, migration dependency or downstream limit that local code-quality measures omit.

premises_supplied: Consequential external constraints and plausible future change needs

premises_remaining: A safe structural intervention and suitable verification
Expected maintenance horizon and incremental benefit/cost

judgments.rationale: The receiving criterion is affordable consequential change, not local cleanliness. EL-030 supplies the cross-disciplinary knowledge needed to distinguish useful structural work from polishing that ignores system consequences. AC-041-K1/K3 show why a retrieved interface fact needs applicable meaning. This does not establish that refactoring frequency causes better outcomes or that every code change needs a broad meeting.
judgments.counterexample: A local simplification looks cheaper while concealing an operational invariant or migration burden. Conversely, a stale trade-off record can wrongly prohibit a now-safe change.
judgments.nontrigger: A disposable component, an imminently retired module or a local behavior-preserving edit with already adequate constraint evidence need not incur a new integration process.
judgments.counter_control: A current interface contract and direct maintainer/consumer check can be adequate. AC-041-K5 permits reuse of unaffected evidence when its dependency premises genuinely remain intact.
judgments.alternative_and_cost: Compare scoped refactoring with isolation, replacement, concise documentation and no change. Count verification, translation, dependent migration, coordination and maintenance costs; do not assume that cleaner code reverses physical or contractual commitments.
judgments.reentry: Reopen when the maintenance horizon, expected change, interface contract, downstream duty or evidence applicability changes.

judgments.rationale: An experiment can be internally tidy yet test the wrong interface or ignore a consequential outcome. EL-030 supplies that missing substantive premise, without providing causal identification or authorization by itself. judgments.rationale: Stopping requires substantive information about the remaining investment. EL-030 can change that warrant without itself selecting retirement.
